title: NMR Analyzer: a dependency-free desktop application for 1D and 2D NMR spectra
description: A desktop application for inspecting and quantifying 1D and 2D NMR spectra. Reads Bruker experiment folders, ACD/Labs .esp exports and JCAMP-DX files; transforms raw free induction decays; and provides phase and baseline correction, peak picking, integration, multiplet classification, pseudo-Voigt deconvolution, contour display of two-dimensional experiments, and a consistency check of measured integrals against a structure supplied as SMILES. Implemented against the Python standard library alone.
